summary.text: A pull quote stating that small, timely investments through the fund can save lives and cut the costs of responding to outbreaks and emergencies.

sections.extract: The CFE has proved that a small investment at the right time can pay life-saving dividends and dramatically reduce the direct costs of controlling outbreaks and responding to emergencies. In 2020, COVID-19 taught the world a hard lesson about the importance of pandemic preparedness. One of the key elements of preparedness is putting the capacity in place to respond immediately when a health emergency strikes. WHO

sections.title: About the WHO Contingency Fund for Emergencies
sections.extract: The WHO Contingency Fund for Emergencies (CFE) was established in 2015 as a key component of the reforms undertaken by WHO to strengthen its role in emergencies. The unique benefit of the CFE is that it can be used to rapidly deploy WHO and global health emergency workforce assets for control and containment of a disease outbreak or to strengthen the health response in humanitarian crises before other funding

sections.title: CFE in health emergencies

summary.text: Reports that in 2020 the fund supported responses to 14 emergencies in 13 countries plus COVID-19, releasing nearly US$ 44 million, with about 80% going to COVID-19 and to two Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

sections.extract: The CFE enabled WHO to mount rapid and sustained responses to 14 separate emergencies in 13 countries and one global response (COVID-19) in 2020. A total of nearly US$ 44 million was released in 2020. Table 1 contains a list of all approved releases by event in 2020. Some 80% of funding released from the CFE went to support just three events in 2020: the two Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo

sections.title: Expenditures

summary.text: Details 2020 fund expenditures, including bridging funding gaps in the protracted North Kivu Ebola response, US$ 5.3 million for the Equateur Ebola outbreak and US$ 12.9 million for early COVID-19 response. It lists other emergencies supported, reports that most small allocations were released within 24 hours, and gives a table of releases by event and a chart of refund rates by year.

sections.extract: last year. In 2020, the CFE continued to support critical, life-saving operations in response to the Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, DRC, which started in 2018. sections.title: Replenishing the CFE

summary.text: Explains that the fund was designed to be revolving but has been hard to replenish, with about 40% of 2020 allocations refunded. It notes that refunds vary by emergency, with most COVID-19 releases reimbursed but Ebola releases less so, and presents a table of releases and refunds by event.

sections.extract: The CFE was conceived by Member States and launched in 2015 as a revolving fund. Costs initially incurred against CFE allocations would be reimbursed by donor funding to the WHO emergency response at country level and unspent funds would be returned. In practice, it has proven difficult to raise the level of resources required at country level to sustainably replenish the CFE in this manner. In 2020, approximately

sections.title: CFE contributions

summary.text: Reports that 13 Member States contributed nearly US$ 23 million in 2020, down from previous years likely because of the focus on funding COVID-19, with Austria joining for the first time. Tables and a chart show contributions by country and for 2015–2020, and the block notes how the fund enabled rapid responses amid multiple crises.

sections.extract: In 2020, 13 Member States generously made contributions to the CFE totaling almost US$ 23 million (Table 3). Austria joined the list of contributors for the first time. Contributions dropped from the previous two years. This was likely to be as a result of the exceptional focus last year on addressing and fully funding the COVID-19 response (Figure 3). See Annex 3 for a complete list of CFE contributors since 2015.

sections.title: ENABLING A SWIFT RESPONSE

summary.text: Gives examples of rapid responses enabled by the fund, including over US$ 2 million released within 24 hours after the Beirut port explosion, support for the Equateur Ebola response, airlifted supplies in Syria, and cyclone response in Vanuatu. It notes support for COVID-19 supply chains and argues that small, early releases had outsized impact. The block also describes WHO's work in Lebanon on medicines, dialysis supplies and a mental health hotline.

sections.extract: For example, more than US$ 2 million was released within 24 hours through the CFE to respond to the urgent humanitarian health needs following the Beirut port explosions. sections.title: Responding to multiple crises in the wake of the Beirut port explosion

summary.text: Describes how WHO's Beirut response continued through a health coordination mechanism, with CERF and European Commission funds complementing the fund. It then introduces the Tropical Cyclone Harold response in Vanuatu, outlining initial assessment and priority activities to maintain health services and limit disease risks.

sections.extract: On 4 August, amidst a rapidly growing COVID-19 outbreak in the Lebanese capital Beirut, a large amount of ammonium nitrate stored in a warehouse at the city’s port exploded, causing widespread casualties and material damage. Several hospitals in the area around the port were either partially or completely destroyed. In all, almost 200 people were killed and 6500 wounded by the blast. Intensive care units throughout

sections.title: Life-saving health response to Tropical Cyclone Harold in Vanuatu

summary.text: Describes WHO support in Vanuatu after Cyclone Harold despite COVID-19 restrictions, including emergency medical team deployment, surveillance tools and repairs to three health facilities, later reimbursed by CERF. It then outlines the health crisis in north-eastern Syria after displacement in 2019, where few health centres were fully functional and WHO used the fund to airlift supplies when borders closed.

sections.extract: Severe Tropical Cyclone (TC) Harold made landfall in Vanuatu on the morning of 6 April 2020. By midday, it was a category five storm lasting for two days, with winds up to 215 kilometres per hour. Causing widespread and severe damage, including collapsed and damaged buildings and wind-strewn debris, TC Harold resulted in multiple deaths and injuries, water- and vector-borne illness, and complicated the national

sections.title: Overcoming closed borders to provide life-saving emergency supplies to north-eastern Syria

summary.text: Shows how fund support helped deliver supplies to partners in north-eastern Syria, then introduces the 11th Ebola outbreak in Equateur Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, which ended in November 2020 with 119 confirmed cases and 55 deaths. It notes the added strain of COVID-19 and the decentralised, community-based response.

sections.extract: to north-eastern Syria Following Turkish military operations in north-eastern Syria (NES) in October 2019, more than 400 000 people were displaced. By March 2020, more than 108 000 people, including some 45 000 children and 27 000 women, remained displaced in the Al-Hasakeh, Ar-Raqqa, and Aleppo governorates. Nine national and five international non-governmental organizations (NGOs) were operational in NES,

sections.title: Defeating the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 11th Ebola outbreak while fighting the COVID-19 pandemic

summary.text: Tells the story of community resistance to Ebola in Mbandaka, where youth leaders persuaded people to accept treatment and vaccination, and describes ultra-cold freezers used to vaccinate in areas without electricity. It credits the fund with launching and sustaining the response and calls for continued vigilance. The block ends with the start of the COVID-19 supply chain section, describing pandemic supply networks supported by early fund releases.

sections.extract: fighting the COVID-19 pandemic Just as another Ebola outbreak in the eastern part of DRC was winding down (and finally declared over on 25 June 2020), a new outbreak was declared on 1 June in the northwestern part of DRC in Equateur Province. sections.title: Rapid scale-up of the COVID-19 Supply Chain System to provide timely and equitable access to critical health supplies

summary.text: Describes how early Contingency Fund for Emergencies releases helped WHO build the COVID-19 supply chain system, including national planning support, supply catalogues, demand management, pooled procurement and stockpiling, and logistics through the World Food Programme. It presents this pooled, equitable approach as a lasting shift in pandemic preparedness and calls for sustainable financing of WHO, with the fund as a key part of emergency response.

sections.extract: and equitable access to critical health supplies Supply chain challenges confronted nearly every sector in 2020 as the COVID-19 pandemic spread globally. narratives.en: Portrait photograph of the foreword's signatory, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General, as named in the sign-off. He wears glasses, a dark suit and a red tie, with a WHO flag in the background.

narratives.en: World map (Figure 1, CFE: overview of responses supported in 2020) with countries shaded and numbered 1–14 by event type: blue for infectious disease outbreaks (e.g. Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Lao People's Democratic Republic, Nigeria), red for complex emergencies (Ethiopia, Mozambique, Nagorno-Karabakh, Sudan, Syrian Arab Republic) and for the technological disaster in Lebanon, and orange for natural disasters (Philippines, Vanuatu). Most supported events are in Africa and the Middle East. A scale bar in kilometres is shown.

narratives.es: Mapa mundial (Figura 1, CFE: panorama de las respuestas apoyadas en 2020) con países sombreados y numerados del 1 al 14 según el tipo de evento: azul para brotes de enfermedades infecciosas (p. ej., República Centroafricana, República Democrática del Congo, República Democrática Popular Lao, Nigeria), rojo para emergencias complejas (Etiopía, Mozambique, Nagorno-Karabaj, Sudán, República Árabe Siria) y para el desastre tecnológico del Líbano, y naranja para desastres naturales (Filipinas, Vanuatu). République centrafricaine, République démocratique du Congo, République démocratique populaire lao, Nigéria), rouge pour les situations d'urgence complexes (Éthiopie, Mozambique, Haut-Karabakh, Soudan, République arabe syrienne) et pour la catastrophe technologique au Liban, et orange pour les catastrophes naturelles (Philippines, Vanuatu). narratives.zh: 照片显示堆放在印有世卫组织标志的箱子上的医疗物资，包括一台盒装BreathCare PAP气道正压通气设备、面罩、护目镜和外科口罩；一只手正伸向一个小盒子。
narratives.es: Fotografía de suministros médicos apilados sobre cajas con el logotipo de la OMS, entre ellos una unidad de presión positiva en las vías respiratorias BreathCare PAP en su caja, pantallas faciales, gafas protectoras y mascarillas quirúrgicas; una mano toma una caja pequeña.
narratives.fr: Photographie de fournitures médicales empilées sur des cartons aux couleurs de l'OMS, dont un appareil de ventilation en pression positive BreathCare PAP dans son carton, des écrans faciaux, des lunettes de protection et des masques chirurgicaux ; une main saisit une petite boîte.
narratives.ru: Фотография медицинских материалов, сложенных на коробках с символикой ВОЗ: аппарат для создания положительного давления в дыхательных путях BreathCare PAP в упаковке, защитные щитки, очки и хирургические маски; рука берёт небольшую коробку.

narratives.en: Photograph at an airport of a large pallet of boxed supplies wrapped in plastic and cargo netting on a loader beside a passenger aircraft; a woman in a face mask and vest gestures towards the pallet.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية في مطار لمنصة نقالة كبيرة من الإمدادات المعبأة في صناديق، ملفوفة بالبلاستيك وشبكة الشحن، على رافعة تحميل بجوار طائرة ركاب؛ وامرأة ترتدي كمامة وسترة تشير نحو المنصة.
narratives.zh: 机场照片：一个装满箱装物资、用塑料膜和货网包裹的大型货盘放在客机旁的装载机上；一名戴口罩、穿背心的女子指向货盘。
narratives.es: Fotografía en un aeropuerto de un gran palé de suministros en cajas, envuelto en plástico y red de carga, sobre un cargador junto a un avión de pasajeros; una mujer con mascarilla y chaleco señala el palé.
narratives.fr: Photographie prise dans un aéroport : une grande palette de fournitures en cartons, emballée de plastique et de filet de fret, sur un chargeur à côté d'un avion de ligne ; une femme portant un masque et un gilet désigne la palette.
narratives.ru: Фотография в аэропорту: большой поддон с коробками, обмотанный плёнкой и грузовой сеткой, на погрузчике рядом с пассажирским самолётом; женщина в маске и жилете указывает на поддон.

narratives.en: Photograph of a woman in a WHO/OMS vest unpacking a carton in front of stacked boxes labelled with the WHO emblem.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لامرأة ترتدي سترة تحمل شعار WHO/OMS وهي تفرغ صندوقًا أمام صناديق مكدّسة عليها شعار منظمة الصحة العالمية.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一名身穿WHO/OMS背心的女子在堆放着印有世卫组织会徽的箱子前开箱取物。
narratives.es: Fotografía de una mujer con un chaleco de WHO/OMS desembalando una caja delante de cajas apiladas con el emblema de la OMS.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'une femme portant un gilet WHO/OMS qui déballe un carton devant des cartons empilés marqués de l'emblème de l'OMS.
narratives.ru: Фотография женщины в жилете WHO/OMS, распаковывающей коробку на фоне сложенных коробок с эмблемой ВОЗ.

narratives.en: Photograph of masked men beside a truck being unloaded of boxes; two wear WHO/OMS vests, one holding folders and the other gesturing with gloved hands.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لرجال يرتدون كمامات بجوار شاحنة تُفرَّغ منها صناديق؛ اثنان منهم يرتديان سترتين تحملان شعار WHO/OMS، أحدهما يحمل ملفات والآخر يشير بيديه المكسوّتين بالقفازات.
narratives.zh: 照片显示几名戴口罩的男子在一辆正在卸箱的卡车旁；其中两人穿着WHO/OMS背心，一人手持文件夹，另一人戴着手套做手势。
narratives.es: Fotografía de hombres con mascarilla junto a un camión del que se descargan cajas; dos llevan chalecos de WHO/OMS, uno sostiene carpetas y el otro gesticula con las manos enguantadas.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'hommes masqués à côté d'un camion que l'on décharge de cartons ; deux portent un gilet WHO/OMS, l'un tient des dossiers et l'autre gesticule de ses mains gantées.
narratives.ru: Фотография мужчин в масках у грузовика, из которого выгружают коробки; двое в жилетах WHO/OMS, один держит папки, другой жестикулирует руками в перчатках.

narratives.en: Photograph of buildings with roofs torn off, exposing bare rafters, beside water; laundry hangs on lines and a group of girls in school uniforms walks past on the grass.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لمبانٍ اقتُلعت أسقفها فظهرت عوارضها الخشبية، بالقرب من الماء؛ والغسيل منشور على الحبال، ومجموعة من الفتيات بالزي المدرسي يمشين على العشب.
narratives.zh: 照片显示水边一些屋顶被掀掉、露出椽木的建筑；晾衣绳上挂着衣物，一群身穿校服的女孩从草地上走过。
narratives.es: Fotografía de edificios con los techos arrancados, que dejan ver las vigas, junto al agua; hay ropa tendida y un grupo de niñas con uniforme escolar camina por el césped.
narratives.fr: Photographie de bâtiments dont les toits ont été arrachés, laissant voir la charpente, au bord de l'eau ; du linge sèche sur des cordes et un groupe de filles en uniforme scolaire passe sur l'herbe.
narratives.ru: Фотография зданий у воды с сорванными крышами и обнажёнными стропилами; на верёвках сушится бельё, по траве проходит группа девочек в школьной форме.

narratives.en: Photograph of a hillside settlement strewn with fallen trees, corrugated metal sheets and debris from damaged houses; a person with a multicoloured umbrella walks along a path.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لمستوطنة على سفح تل تتناثر فيها الأشجار المقتلعة وألواح المعدن المموج وحطام المنازل المتضررة؛ وشخص يحمل مظلة متعددة الألوان يسير على ممر.
narratives.zh: 照片显示山坡上的居民点散落着倒伏的树木、瓦楞铁皮和受损房屋的残骸；一个打着彩色雨伞的人沿小路行走。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un asentamiento en una ladera cubierto de árboles caídos, chapas onduladas y escombros de casas dañadas; una persona con un paraguas multicolor camina por un sendero.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un village à flanc de colline jonché d'arbres abattus, de tôles ondulées et de débris de maisons endommagées ; une personne munie d'un parapluie multicolore marche sur un chemin.
narratives.ru: Фотография поселения на склоне холма, усыпанного поваленными деревьями, листами профнастила и обломками повреждённых домов; человек с разноцветным зонтом идёт по тропинке.

narratives.en: Photograph of a convoy of trucks bearing World Health Organization signs parked along a road, with two people in WHO-branded clothing standing in the foreground.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لقافلة شاحنات تحمل لافتات منظمة الصحة العالمية متوقفة على طول طريق، وشخصان يرتديان ملابس تحمل شعار المنظمة يقفان في المقدمة.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一列挂有世界卫生组织标牌的卡车停在路边，前景中站着两名身穿世卫组织标志服装的人员。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un convoy de camiones con carteles de la Organización Mundial de la Salud estacionados a lo largo de una carretera, con dos personas con ropa de la OMS en primer plano.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un convoi de camions portant des panneaux de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé, stationnés le long d'une route, avec au premier plan deux personnes en tenue aux couleurs de l'OMS.
narratives.ru: Фотография колонны грузовиков с табличками Всемирной организации здравоохранения, стоящих вдоль дороги; на переднем плане два человека в одежде с символикой ВОЗ.

narratives.en: Photograph of a smiling young man in a white T-shirt with USAID and other logos, seated in front of a doorway with a patterned curtain.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لشاب مبتسم يرتدي قميصًا أبيض عليه شعار USAID وشعارات أخرى، جالسًا أمام مدخل عليه ستارة منقوشة.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一名面带笑容的年轻男子，身穿印有USAID等标志的白色T恤，坐在挂着花纹门帘的门口前。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un joven sonriente con una camiseta blanca con el logotipo de USAID y otros, sentado delante de una puerta con una cortina estampada.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un jeune homme souriant vêtu d'un t-shirt blanc portant le logo de l'USAID et d'autres logos, assis devant une porte à rideau imprimé.
narratives.ru: Фотография улыбающегося молодого человека в белой футболке с логотипом USAID и другими логотипами, сидящего у дверного проёма с узорчатой занавеской.

narratives.en: Photograph of a health worker in a yellow protective gown, goggles, hair cover and blue gloves giving an injection in the upper arm of a seated person.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لعامل صحي يرتدي رداءً واقيًا أصفر ونظارات واقية وغطاءً للشعر وقفازات زرقاء، وهو يعطي حقنة في أعلى ذراع شخص جالس.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一名身穿黄色防护服、戴护目镜、发罩和蓝色手套的卫生工作者正在为一名坐着的人在上臂注射。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un trabajador de salud con bata protectora amarilla, gafas, gorro y guantes azules aplicando una inyección en la parte superior del brazo de una persona sentada.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un agent de santé en blouse de protection jaune, lunettes, charlotte et gants bleus, qui fait une injection dans le haut du bras d'une personne assise.
narratives.ru: Фотография медицинского работника в жёлтом защитном халате, очках, шапочке и синих перчатках, делающего инъекцию в плечо сидящему человеку.

narratives.en: Photograph of a warehouse with orange and blue pallet racks holding shrink-wrapped boxes; two people, one in a high-visibility vest, check items at the right.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لمستودع به رفوف منصات نقالة برتقالية وزرقاء تحمل صناديق ملفوفة بالبلاستيك؛ وشخصان، أحدهما يرتدي سترة عالية الوضوح، يفحصان المواد على اليمين.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一个仓库，橙蓝色货架上放着用收缩膜包裹的箱子；右侧两人正在清点物品，其中一人穿着反光背心。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un almacén con estanterías para palés naranjas y azules con cajas envueltas en plástico; a la derecha, dos personas, una con chaleco reflectante, revisan artículos.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un entrepôt équipé de rayonnages à palettes orange et bleus chargés de cartons filmés ; à droite, deux personnes, dont l'une en gilet haute visibilité, vérifient des articles.
narratives.ru: Фотография склада с оранжево-синими паллетными стеллажами, на которых стоят коробки в плёнке; справа два человека, один в сигнальном жилете, проверяют товары.

narratives.en: Photograph of a man in a blue World Health Organization T-shirt, seen from behind, walking towards a blue warehouse with a World Health Organization sign.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لرجل يرتدي قميصًا أزرق يحمل اسم منظمة الصحة العالمية، يظهر من الخلف وهو يسير نحو مستودع أزرق عليه لافتة المنظمة.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一名身穿蓝色世界卫生组织T恤的男子背对镜头，走向一座挂有世界卫生组织标牌的蓝色仓库。
narratives.es: Fotografía de un hombre con una camiseta azul de la Organización Mundial de la Salud, visto de espaldas, caminando hacia un almacén azul con un cartel de la Organización Mundial de la Salud.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'un homme vu de dos, vêtu d'un t-shirt bleu de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé, marchant vers un entrepôt bleu portant un panneau de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé.
narratives.ru: Фотография мужчины в синей футболке Всемирной организации здравоохранения, снятого со спины, идущего к синему складу с вывеской Всемирной организации здравоохранения.

narratives.en: Photograph of a woman in a green shirt seated at a desk covered with medicine bottles and record books in a small clinic; the wall behind has a notice board with a hand-drawn catchment-area map, contact lists and health posters.
narratives.ar: صورة فوتوغرافية لامرأة ترتدي قميصًا أخضر جالسة إلى مكتب تغطيه زجاجات الأدوية ودفاتر السجلات في عيادة صغيرة؛ وعلى الجدار خلفها لوحة إعلانات عليها خريطة مرسومة باليد لمنطقة التغطية وقوائم أرقام اتصال وملصقات صحية.
narratives.zh: 照片显示一名身穿绿色衬衫的女子坐在一个小诊所里，桌上摆满药瓶和记录本；身后墙上的布告板贴着手绘的服务区域地图、联系人名单和健康宣传海报。
narratives.es: Fotografía de una mujer con camisa verde sentada ante un escritorio cubierto de frascos de medicamentos y libros de registro en un pequeño consultorio; en la pared, un tablón de anuncios con un mapa dibujado a mano de la zona de captación, listas de contactos y carteles de salud.
narratives.fr: Photographie d'une femme en chemise verte assise à un bureau couvert de flacons de médicaments et de registres dans un petit dispensaire ; au mur, un tableau d'affichage avec une carte dessinée à la main de la zone de desserte, des listes de contacts et des affiches de santé.
narratives.ru: Фотография женщины в зелёной рубашке за столом с флаконами лекарств и журналами учёта в небольшом медпункте; на стене за ней доска объявлений с нарисованной от руки картой зоны обслуживания, списками контактов и плакатами о здоровье.
